name: Staged: four-screen run on the right, work desk by the window, chair bed by the door
notes:
Staged pick (F-41), redesigned 2026-10-23 for F-62 and F-63. The usable floor is a 106 x 106 square: furniture from y 12 and upholstery from y 18 off the hatched heater wall (F-33, heater-depth-assumed), nothing below y 116 in front of the wardrobe or below y 122 in front of the door (F-31: the 36" landings, which hold the swings).
desk-1 MITTZON 55 1/8x31 1/2 white, electric sit/stand: right wall, rot 90, x 74.5-106, y 13.6-68.75; F-33 7.6" from the heater face; F-35 47" from its front to the work desk, 58" to the BESTÅ · fits.
desk-2 MITTZON 47 1/4x31 1/2: right wall below it, y 68.75-116; F-31 6" above the door's landing and on the edge of the wardrobe's (assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet); F-35 41.4" to the chair bed · fits. The personal run is 102 3/8" (F-62): four 32" screens, two per desk on HUANUO arms, the middle pair flat and the outer pair angled in about 38 degrees, so the array spans about 101". Flat they would need 113", and no wall here has more than 110"; the run starts 1 5/8" below the heater line so it ends at the wardrobe's 36" landing, 6" short of the door's, and leaves the chair bed's foot room under desk-2.
desk-3 TRAVSPORT 47 1/4x27 1/2 oak effect, electric sit/stand: left wall, rot 270, x 0-27.5, y 12-59.25: the separate work station, the job laptop on the ELLOVEN beside one 32" monitor with about 5" to spare; F-33 6" from the heater face; F-35 47" from its front to desk-1 · fits. Both desk walls run perpendicular to the window, so no screen faces it or has it behind.
chair-1 FLINTAN: the personal run's center, x 46-74, y 50.8-78.8, on the KOLON · fits. chair-2 FLINTAN: the work desk, x 28-56, y 21.6-49.6; F-33 its seat 15.6" from the heater face · fits. The two chairs sit 1.2" apart in y, so both stations work at once.
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with door 23 5/8x16 1/2x25 1/4 (F-63): left wall, rot 270, x 0-16.5, y 59.25-82.9, the chair bed's side table and closed storage for paper, cables and the guest's bedding; F-32 29.5" clear in front of its door to chair-1 · fits.
chairbed-1 IKEA PS 2026 chair bed: left wall, rot 270, x 0-33.1, y 82.9-114.4; F-31 1.6" above the wardrobe's 36" landing (assumed-position:closet); F-30 a 41.4" walkway between it and desk-2 from the door to both stations. F-62's small daybed: closed 31 1/2 x 33 1/8", a third of the old HEMNES. Opened it runs 79 7/8" to x 79.9: raise desk-2 and its last 5 3/8" slides under it. The MITTZON's legs stand near each end of the desk with T-feet running front to back, and the bed's door-side edge is 1.6" from desk-2's end, so angle the foot about two degrees toward the window to pass between the feet. F-34 37.6" of floor along its door side · fits.
lamp-1 TÅGARP: bottom-left corner, x 0.5-9.5, y 142-151, left of the wardrobe's landing (assumed-position:closet), the room's uplighter · fits. plant-1 FEJKA monstera: x 1-8.5, y 117-124.5, left of the wardrobe's landing · fits.
rug-1 LOHALS 4'4"x6'5" flatweave (rug layer): x 25-77, y 20-97, the aisle under both chairs, 2.5" under each desk wall. rug-2 KOLON (rug layer): x 35.1-74.5, y 41.2-88.4, the clear chair mat under chair-1 on top of the rug.
lamp-2 RÖDFLIK (top): the work desk's window end. lamp-3 RÖDFLIK (top): on the BESTÅ, the chair bed's reading lamp. art-1 PJÄTTERYD 3-pack (top): left wall, the three 22" canvases in a row 1" apart (68"), y 64-132, 46-68" up, over the BESTÅ, the chair bed and the plant.
Extras: the two HOPPVALS blinds; two HUANUO arms and two FÖRSÄSONG cable trays on the personal run; the FREIVID mat; the ELLOVEN; the guest's twin duvet cover, insert and pillow; a cushion and the throw on the chair bed.
Not placed: the 2026-10-22 pieces MICKE (not sit/stand, 19 5/8" deep), ALEX and BILLY (no wall left for them), HEMNES (not small, F-62), MARKUS and CENTERHALV (FLINTAN instead); SKÅDIS (above a sit/stand desk the monitor covers it); TERTIAL (no-dimensions).
Prices: the new pieces as of 2026-10-23; the reused ones (FLINTAN, TÅGARP, RÖDFLIK, FEJKA, LOHALS, PJÄTTERYD, HOPPVALS, FÖRSÄSONG, ELLOVEN, bedding and textiles) as of 2026-10-22, price-stale (F-02).
